name: Agent Reliability and Teaching Lab
promise: Teach and test bounded agent behavior with deterministic gates.
completion_criteria: A shared eval covers path confinement, malformed plans, retries, budgets, rollback, and reviewer artifacts.
Teaching examples remain readable and intentionally smaller than production harnesses.
Generic personas and prompt chains become skills, curriculum, or fixtures rather than competing runtimes.
Shared packages have at least two verified consumers before promotion.

waves.objective: Define adversarial reliability fixtures as ExperimentRuns.
waves.acceptance: Confinement, malformed output, retry, budget, rollback, and reviewer cases have deterministic expected outcomes.
waves.runtime_followup: Execute the fixtures against a live agent loop instead of scoring declared policy expectations.

waves.objective: Measure declared reliability-gate coverage across Looping Box, SSSF, and Agentic Harness.
waves.acceptance: Source-derived coverage and limitations are retained per harness, with runtime fixture execution explicitly outstanding.
waves.runtime_followup: Run the fixture battery inside each harness runtime; source markers are not execution.

waves.objective: Extract only proven shared behavior and curriculum.
waves.acceptance: Every extraction has two consumers or remains local; duplicate generic runtimes are not expanded.
waves.runtime_followup: Confirm each counted consumer imports the component at runtime, not only by text reference.

waves.objective: Apply the two-observed-consumers craft rule to the measured shared-component inventory.
waves.acceptance: Measured references determine retain or proposed-demotion dispositions; no package move or runtime-import claim is made.
waves.runtime_followup: Re-audit after any demotion actually moves code back to its home repository.

waves.objective: Mine AI Staff and prompt-chain source cases into deterministic curriculum fixtures.
waves.acceptance: The source-derived fixtures are content-linked and contract-valid; executing them against live agents remains outstanding.
waves.runtime_followup: Execute the mined cases and score real agent behavior against them.
